source_crosschecks.finding: claude_frage constructs headless claude -p with permission mode and unconditional --disallowedTools Bash, but the examined invocation does not bind an exact settings/plugin/hook artifact identity and falls back to cwd=Path.home() when cwd is absent.

The donor manifest declares seven hook events including PreToolUse(*) and Stop routed through scripts/stern.py hook. Repository declaration alone is not a receipt that this manifest was loaded by a particular headless invocation.

The donor itself documents that plugin hooks depend on installation/enabling and that some global hooks are separate host-level settings. It also records a live case where a session launched without plugin hook wiring did not join the room. Therefore ambient installed settings/plugin identity is materially relevant and must not be inferred from repository presence.

frank_erinnerung_schreiben directly forwards subject/value to stern conversation-memory write; frank_forschung neu_anstossen dispatches when a nonempty question is supplied; only frank_auftrag_stellen is mechanically routed through the explicit two-stage confirmation state machine in the examined voice tool dispatcher.

gespraech_erinnerung_schreiben performs a durable SQLite insert into the dedicated gespraech_erinnerung table after only nonempty subject/value validation. chatgpt_senden is a real subprocess wrapper around the host-level chatgpt_burst_worker_v2.sh send path and is not merely a cached-read operation. No external/provider action was invoked in this Triggerword-5 run.

semantic_atoms.what_it_does: Voice-delegated headless Claude is partially constrained by a hard Bash denial, while the exact settings/plugin/hook bytes governing other tools are ambient rather than invocation-bound in the examined launcher.

A Realtime model function call can request a durable conversation-memory insert without passing through the external-task confirmation state machine and without carrying Realtime call_id into the stern write helper.
semantic_atoms.containment: The write is narrower than arbitrary UnifiedDB mutation because stern confines it to the dedicated gespraech_erinnerung table.

semantic_atoms.what_it_does: The Realtime tool description says new research is explicit-user-request-only, but the mechanical neu_anstossen branch checks only for a nonempty question before background dispatch toward stern.chatgpt_senden.

The six Realtime tools mix read-only state access, durable internal memory mutation, asynchronous external/delegated work, research dispatch and session control under one model-facing function-calling surface, while only one class currently has an explicit mechanical two-step confirmation gate.

HeadlessExecutionBinding/v1.rule: A delegated headless execution may receive runtime enforcement credit only when the invocation is bound to the exact installed settings/plugin/hook identity and relevant working-source identity. Repository manifest existence is not hook-firing evidence.
preserve: hard Bash denial as a useful donor restriction
must_add: external proof that expected hooks actually fire

MemoryAdmission/v1.pipeline: RealtimeFunctionCall -> MemoryCandidate -> deterministic MemoryAdmission -> dedicated canonical memory writer -> MemoryReceipt
MemoryAdmission/v1.rule: Do not blindly reuse the external-task confirmation policy; durable memory requires its own typed admission because it is an internal canonical-state mutation with different risk and semantics.
MemoryAdmission/v1.preserve: Keep the donor's narrow dedicated conversation-memory table unless a later canonical migration explicitly replaces it.

ResearchRequestAdmission/v1.pipeline: RealtimeFunctionCall -> ResearchRequestCandidate -> HumanIntentDecision -> Capability/Privacy/EconomicAdmission -> bounded dispatch -> request/response receipt
ResearchRequestAdmission/v1.rule: aktion=lesen remains a read-only cached-result path; aktion=neu_anstossen is a distinct outward request and cannot rely only on model-facing prose saying 'explicit request only'.
ResearchRequestAdmission/v1.current_free_only_note: No provider route is admitted by current 9.13AC steering in this run, so network/provider execution remains zero.

VoiceToolAdmissionMatrix/v1.rule: Each tool class receives its own deterministic admission contract; successful execution cannot retroactively create missing intent or authority.

contradictions.a: Donor plugin configuration declares broad PreToolUse/Stop hook wiring.
contradictions.b: Voice headless launcher does not bind the exact installed plugin/settings/hook identity; donor install docs confirm hook reachability can differ by launch/install state.
contradictions.resolution_target: Triggerword-4 external source/build-bound hook-firing probe without modifying Frank Harness.

contradictions.a: Voice task execution has a mechanical two-stage confirmation path.
contradictions.b: Durable memory and new research requests are mechanically dispatched through separate paths without equivalent typed admission, while their restrictions mostly live in model-facing descriptions.
contradictions.resolution_target: Typed per-class admission matrix, not one generic confirmation gate.

hypothesis: Frankenstein 2.0 can retain the useful low-latency voice and headless delegation mechanisms if GRID10 moves intent/admission/effect semantics into typed deterministic boundaries while leaving model outputs as candidates and preserving fast reactive paths.
counterhypothesis: Ambient Claude installation policy and ordinary model compliance may already make the current donor sufficiently safe in practice; however this would still not establish reproducible source-bound enforcement or fail-closed authority and requires installed-host evidence.

preserve hard Bash denial but audit non-Bash mutating tools through the final deterministic effect boundary
introduce MemoryCandidate/MemoryAdmission with Realtime call identity and epistemic/privacy/retention provenance
